summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting on re-login  ### What I found (read-only audit, no code changes made)  **Backend (`modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`) is correct.** Every route validates the `arca_session` cookie (or `Authorization: Bearer`) via `getSession()`, derives `userId` server-side from that session, and every query is scoped with `eq(watchlists.user_id, userId)`. There's no client-supplied user id, no anonymous/default watchlist fallback, and no `localStorage` used for watchlist data anywhere in the client (`localStorage` is only used for theme, in `Layout.tsx`). C
